cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: More Official Than You
cards.instruction: Turn every suggestion into a contest over whose method, title, precedent, or paperwork is more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Your bow at the ceremony was adequate. Mine follows the founder's original diagram. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The founder asked us to wave instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. His original diagram is in the constitution. My bow follows that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you have a signed exception. I'll bow on behalf of everyone still governed by the constitution.

mechanism: A negotiates a ceremony greeting that accommodates B wave while claiming A constitutional bow represents the higher authority.
confusable: Unlike choosing manners, A makes founder words and constitution compete for legitimacy.
comparison: B signed personal programme competes with A general constitution, unlike the picnic appendix structure.
seedUse: D187-b founder diagram and signed programme; S02-b adapts the performance instead of losing B participation.
